summary: SnyPy is an open-source, on-premise application designed for managing and storing code snippets. As a self-hosted pastebin alternative, it provides a centralised repository to keep frequently used code blocks organised. Because specific feature lists are not provided, it functions fundamentally like other web-based snippet organisers.
goodFor: Developers who want a private, self-hosted web interface to store and retrieve personal code snippets without relying on third-party cloud pastebins.
watchOut: The project has no tagged releases and zero repository stars, indicating an early stage of development with potential stability risks and a lack of community support. It also competes in a crowded category with much more mature alternatives.
deployNotes: Since it is built with Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
